moments.title: Autumn is officially here!
moments.blurb: The Autumnal Equinox, marking the start of astronomical autumn in the Northern Hemisphere, occurred early this morning.

angles.name: General autumn arrival
angles.copy: The leaves are turning, the nights are drawing in... and astronomical autumn officially began early this morning! Time for cosy vibes.

angles.name: Seasonal shift
angles.copy: Goodbye summer, hello autumn! The equinox has officially flipped the switch, bringing shorter days and that crisp autumnal air.

moments.title: Premier League Matchday 5 fallout
moments.blurb: Manchester City remains top after Matchday 5, with Arsenal's perfect start ending in a 3-0 defeat to Brighton before the international break.

angles.name: General review
angles.copy: Manchester City are still flying high at the top of the Premier League after Matchday 5, but Arsenal's perfect run is over! What were your highlights from the weekend's action?

angles.name: Arsenal defeat
angles.copy: Brighton put an end to Arsenal's perfect start with a stunning 3-0 win in the Premier League. Big statement from the Seagulls!

moments.title: Exeter City in EFL Trophy action
moments.blurb: Exeter City are playing Cheltenham Town tonight in the English Football League Trophy.

angles.name: Match build-up
angles.copy: It's EFL Trophy night! Exeter City are on the road to face Cheltenham Town. Can the Grecians bring home a win? Kick-off at 7pm!

angles.name: Pre-match excitement
angles.copy: Football fix tonight! Exeter City takes on Cheltenham in the EFL Trophy. Get behind the lads!

moments.title: Women's Champions League action tonight

angles.name: Match build-up

angles.name: Support for teams
angles.copy: Who are you cheering for in the Women's Champions League tonight? Arsenal and Man City are flying the flag for England!

angles.copy: Niall Horan brings his 'Dinner Party Live On Tour' to Birmingham tonight! Get ready for an incredible show!

moments.title: Sienna Spiro tops UK Singles Chart

angles.name: New Number 1

angles.name: Chart rundown
angles.copy: The UK Singles Chart is in! Sienna Spiro is at the top, but Ella Langley and Miley Cyrus are making waves too. Your weekend playlist sorted!

angles.name: Whitesnake tribute
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to Whitesnake's iconic frontman, David Coverdale! Still got that unmistakable voice.

moments.title: UK weather: Warm start, unsettled outlook
moments.blurb: The Met Office forecasts a warm start to the week for parts of the UK, especially the South East, with increasing rain and cooler temperatures in the North and West mid-week.

angles.name: Today's forecast
angles.copy: Warm for many in the South East today, but rain is pushing into the North and West. Grab that brolly if you're up there!

angles.name: Mid-week change
angles.copy: Enjoy the warmth while it lasts! The Met Office is forecasting a cooler, more unsettled feel for the UK later this week.
